messages:
tessa-ops: Heads-up: scheduling a short rolling maintenance 23:45-00:30 UTC targeting apac-edge-rack-21 and apac-edge-rack-22. Goal: apply NIC microcode, reboot 1 node per rack, and reseed KV cache to prevent thermal-induced retries we saw today. Expect brief p95 blips and ~7% capacity dip. Plan attached below.

liam-infra: ack. which specific nodes? can we push traffic to warm standby within apac before routing to eu/us?

tessa-ops: targets: rack-21 node-04, rack-22 node-03. We'll bias to apac-standby then fallback to eu if needed. No customer-facing pool changes unless we exceed rollback thresholds.

alex-sre: tagging runbook. I'll monitor SLOs. Abort criteria: p95 > 600ms for 10m OR error-rate >1.5x baseline for 8m. If abort, full reroute to eu/us and spawn 3 burst nodes.

anya-mlops: please run a 5% canary for 8 minutes after kvseed so I can run quick quality checks.

tessa-ops: Will provision 3x temporary burst GPUs (dedicated-burst-temp) for 60m. Estimated cost +$260; ticket CT-2026-481 created. Maintenance ticket INC-2026-2077 created. Preflight reminder 23:25 UTC.

Commands (ops):
```
# cordon + drain
infractl cordon node apac-edge-rack-21-04
infractl drain node apac-edge-rack-21-04 --grace 60
# reboot
infractl reboot node apac-edge-rack-21-04 --warm
# kvseed primer
infractl kvseed --node apac-edge-rack-21-04 --primer apac-thermal-prim
# canary routing
infractl route-set canary gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03 --pct 5
```

liam-infra: LGTM. I'll stand by to add burst nodes if latency remains high.

alex-sre: I'll post minute-by-minute snapshots to #inc-ops-live during the window and annotate any breaches.

anya-mlops: after canary I'll share median/p95 and a couple of sample diffs. If quality looks off we stop and rollback.

tessa-ops: Thanks team. I'll post a short support blurb 30m before and update status page if anything prolonged. :white_check_mark:
